ops.title: 2026-07-04 incident: fusekit overlay resolveFileConflict (mtime-wins, loser destroyed) overwrote ~15 real session transcripts with meta-only stubs during backend conversions (also 2026-06-15, unnoticed); fixed fusekit v0.29.2 quarantine + cc-pool v0.39.1
ops.body:
The "blank session resume" reports were **cc-pool destroying transcripts, not an FP read bug**:
`fusekit overlay/migrate.go resolveFileConflict` resolved regular-file collisions by newest
mtime and destroyed the loser (rename-over / unlink, no quarantine). During conversions/heals,
meta-only session stubs (last-prompt/ai-title lines, written by claude resume attempts through
broken overlay views in the holder-crash era) outdated real multi-MB transcripts in the shared
`~/.claude/projects` and won. Two events: 2026-06-15 (~4 victims, unnoticed) and 2026-07-04
16:07–16:12 (~11 victims, incl. the delete-the-delightful-allen plan session 61b92778). Full
victim table + mechanism: `ccn doc show 85e1359`. Content unrecoverable (no TM/snapshots,
inodes unlinked); subagent dirs, plan files, history.jsonl survive. Trigger: daemon restart
found store rows still fuse-era → auto-converged nfs→symlink→fileprovider → HealStrandedPrivate
merged stub copies over base. Jul-3 CLI-side `ccp migrate` runs destroyed more without durable
logs (daemon.log holds only 33 conflict lines).

**Fix (fusekit v0.29.2, consumed by cc-pool v0.39.1)**: loser quarantined at
`<dst>.conflict-<loser-mtime-unixnano>` via atomic hardlink (EEXIST + differing bytes fails
loud; identical bytes = interrupted pass, re-runs cleanly); never unlinked. Codex-refuted the
first draft's stat-then-rename TOCTOU (os.Rename silently clobbers — Link is the only atomic
no-clobber). RULE: never run `ccp migrate`/`doctor --fix`/daemon convergence with a pre-v0.29.2
resolver binary. Quarantine files are plain siblings — cruft sweeps may collect them after
review. Deliberately NOT quarantined: identical-bytes dedup, mergeDir spec.Skipped cruft
(`._`, `.fuse_hidden`, `.nfs.` — disposable by construction).

Verified separately: resume of INTACT sessions through FP domains works (headless
`--fork-session` through acct-01 read full history) — `projects/` is a carve-out symlink to
base everywhere, transcripts were never per-account. Related: [[fp-backend-rollout]],
[[holder-bg-band-incident]], [[claude-pool-project]].
